name: Devin
description: Devin is Cognition's AI software engineer, with a v3 API for sessions, knowledge and playbooks.
auth_notes: Service user API keys (cog_ prefix) or personal access tokens, sent as Authorization Bearer; legacy v1/v2 keys are deprecated.
gate_detail: Keys are provisioned in Settings > Devin API by creating a service user with an RBAC role. Required plan or admin rights are not stated; enterprise PATs need admin policy and approval.
api_scope: v3 organization and enterprise endpoints covering session management, knowledge, playbooks and secrets, plus enterprise analytics, audit logs and billing.
mcp_notes: Official Devin MCP server over Streamable HTTP; requires an API key and a Devin account.
blocker_detail: Credentials require provisioning a service user in settings, which needs account admin access; plan requirements are not established in the sources.

evidence.quote: Copy the API key — the key starts with cog_ and is shown only once, right after provisioning
Use the key in the Authorization header of every API request
Provision a service user in Settings > Devin API ( Service users tab) for an organization
Assign a role that controls which endpoints the service user can access.
Approval required Members submit a PAT request; an enterprise admin must approve it before the token can be created

issues: Required plan tier for API access is not stated.
REST style is inferred from curl examples.
Webhooks and sandbox are not described.
